conclusion: The isolated processor reduced supervised transition loss from 1.16781 to values as low as 0.01684, but unseen exactness remained flat: T1 was 0.50 and T16 was 0.1146 at step 256. With 636 unique keys among 640 training transitions and only 1.25 percent full-history overlap into holdout, the 64-task curriculum elicited sparse-trajectory memorization rather than reusable transition algebra. Continuing to step 1024 was not authorized.
next_mechanism: Attach zero-output opcode-isolated neural expert heads and train them on an eight-times-broader exact transition distribution. Preserve the shared recurrent processor, public action compiler, teacher-free evaluation and frozen answer readout.
claim_boundary: Negative bounded 1.5B transfer result only; no answer-level, resident-32B, fusion, frontier or WOW Signal authority.
